results.question: Who wrote the change that caused INC-0285?
results.answer:
INC-0285 (SEV3, auth-service): Auth Service: updates not visible to customers; started 2026-03-20 11:36 UTC, resolved 2026-03-20 14:44 UTC [E1].
Root cause: Deployment DEP-0211 (auth-service v1.15.0) shipped PR-1345 "Avoid cache stampede on auth invalidation" (commit f2ddcee), which changed `services/auth-service/auth_service/cache.py` [E1]. `AuthCache.invalidate` stopped deleting keys and only refreshed their TTL (900s), so updated records kept being served from stale cache entries [E1].
Resolution: Rolled back auth-service to v1.14.0 (DEP-0212) at 13:12 UTC; metrics recovered by 14:44 UTC [E1]. Permanent fix PR-1349 ("Delete cache entries on invalidation again") shipped in DEP-0223 (v1.15.1) [E1].
